label: same-author frozen simulated test; post-hoc offline audit
data_source: data/gate8_1/benchmark_cases_v1.jsonl extracted from commit 7824bb7; v1 traces

scoring_policy.correct_answer: Response cites at least one allowed KB doc and covers the required policy fact; no invented fee, balance, transaction state, or credential.
scoring_policy.no_supported_doc: If no KB document addresses the question, a handoff/clarification with no fabricated business fact is acceptable; a confident unsupported answer is a failure.
scoring_policy.scoring_bug: Only a FAQ whose v1 response is grounded but was marked failed solely because expected_terms used the first word may be corrected.
scoring_policy.needs_manual_review: Mark when the trace is insufficient to distinguish a grounded answer from a plausible but unsupported answer.
